immutable_execution_definitions.canonical_text: source text with LF line endings only; no detokenization
immutable_execution_definitions.t_train: sum(len(tau(document_text))) over frozen canonical train documents; no BOS; no packing; no crop
immutable_execution_definitions.p_scaling: pinned base_train scaling parameter count recorded per depth
immutable_execution_definitions.checkpoint_rule: final checkpoint at fixed D_3x budget
immutable_execution_definitions.model_selection_rule: exact minimum final val_bpb_full; sub-0.01 BPB gaps are practically indistinguishable in one-seed interpretation
immutable_execution_definitions.byte_unigram: Laplace add-one smoothing p(b)=(c[b]+1)/(N+256), trained on train UTF-8 bytes only
immutable_execution_definitions.article_fallback: use deterministic heading parser; if any parser invariant fails, use reconstructed_row_70_15_15

gates.name: Environment
acceptance_checks: nanochat commit pinned to 92d63d4 full SHA

gates.name: Audit
acceptance_checks: null, empty, length, Unicode, @-@ residue, and duplicates audited
eligible drop rate is at most 5 percent

gates.name: Split
acceptance_checks: split unit automatically selected by parser invariants or row fallback
70/15/15 deterministic hash split written if original split unavailable
exact overlap across train, validation, and test is zero

gates.name: Shards
acceptance_checks: zstd compression and row group 1024 recorded
at least one training shard and lexicographically final validation shard
test absent from active training directory

gates.name: Tokenizer
acceptance_checks: bytes per token logged for train, validation, and test

gates.name: Budget desk calculation
acceptance_checks: T_train counted by frozen no-BOS/no-packing/no-crop definition
P_total and P_scaling recorded per depth
num_iterations, total_batch_size, and D_actual recorded per depth

gates.name: Smoke
acceptance_checks: active data path verified as non-ClimbMix

transition_rule: Gate I may not begin unless every Gate A through H has status pass. A status never overwrites prior event history; corrections append an event.
